messages:
alex_s: Hey team — looped in @dd-partner. Goal: ship a Datadog + OpenTelemetry integration bundle (collector config + sample dashboards + quickstart) for the marketplace listing. Target: 4 weeks. Who can own the G2M checklist?

maria_g: I can drive the checklist. Will need eng help for the collector config and a small sample app for the docs.

sam_ops: happy to own collector config + infra tests. Thinking a lightweight collector config that forwards traces + resource attributes to Datadog.

luca_eng: I can do the sample app and a tiny shim that demonstrates Redwood tracing headers for distributed traces. ETA ~10 days.

riley_pm: We should capture messaging and launch assets too — I'll draft a short joint announcement and a one-pager for Sales. Katie, can you prep a pocket pitch for partners?

katie_sales: Yep. I'll make a 2-slide pitch + a partner FAQ. Need list of customer-facing benefits and sample metrics (latency reduction, observability coverage).

alex_s: Great. Sam — can you add a CI job that validates the collector config against a local OTEL collector container? Something like: 
```
# run in CI (docker)
docker run --rm -v $(pwd)/collector-config.yaml:/etc/otel/config.yaml otel/opentelemetry-collector:latest 
```
and a smoke test that posts a trace to collector and asserts Datadog receives it (we can use the dd test API).

sam_ops: yep. I'll create GH issue and a small GH Actions workflow. Will use an env var DD_TEST_API_KEY for the smoke test.

maria_g: For dashboards — let's produce: 1) end-to-end trace view, 2) service map with Redwood model service annotated, 3) a cost/latency dashboard (tokens per request vs p95 latency). Any objections?

luca_eng: sounds right. I can export a Datadog dashboard JSON and add it to the repo under /examples/dashboards.

dd_partner_bot: partner/checklist: Datadog: confirm ingestion schema, dashboard JSON, sample traces, shared GH repo access, co-branded assets. (auto-message)

riley_pm: Timeline proposal: Week 1: configs + sample app + GH repo. Week 2: dashboards + docs. Week 3: internal review + partner review. Week 4: marketplace listing + announce. Ok?

alex_s: Works for me. Two asks: 1) include an example of Redwood's routing header in the trace so customers can see model-version in trace attributes; 2) a short note on security (what data we send to Datadog, PII handling).

maria_g: I'll add a security blurb and a KMS note for customers using Private (vpc/on-prem) deployments.

sam_ops: Opening GH issue now: 1793001234-obs-integration — I'll assign to @luca_eng for sample app and @maria_g for docs.

luca_eng: confirmed. I'll push a minimal node/python sample that adds trace attributes: model.name, model.version, request.id.

katie_sales: FYI I'm prepping a partner briefing for tomorrow @ 11am PT — will include the draft pitch and ask Datadog for co-marketing timing.

alex_s: awesome. Next sync in 48h unless blockers. Throw blockers here or DM. :thumbsup:

maria_g: small follow-up — can someone share the Datadog ingestion endpoint and recommended attribute names? @dd-partner can you paste the prod namespace we should use?

dd_partner_bot: dd/ops: Use api.datadoghq.com for traces; recommended attributes: service, env, dd.trace_id, model.name, model.version, redwood.request_id. Will follow up with dashboard template.

sam_ops: noted. I'll add those attribute names to the collector config and the smoke test.

alex_s: Thanks all — saving this thread as the canonical checklist. I’ll convert to a shared GH project board after the initial issues are opened.
